Name: CP TheyThem Abigail
Author: sarahleia
Description:
hey y'all! this is my first mod so it's pretty simple, it just changes a bit of dialogue for Abigail, Pierre, and Caroline so that Abigail is always referred to with they/them pronouns, because, idk, Abigail just doesn't seem cis to me. 

This is content patcher, but if you want to download character xnb's and replace them, i've uploaded those too. thanks to ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/14247299]hanatsuki[/url] for all their help! also if you haven't check out their awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722/]gender neutrality mod[/url]!

How to Install:
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.

That should be it! This runs alright on my computer but I haven't tested it elsewhere so let me know if you have issues! Also let me know if you notice some dialogue I've missed!
